comment: Units (stage 6 PR 3a, ADR 0024, decisions of 2026-11-09): groups of people who walk over the map in the ticks of the live game (time.json: 10 ticks = 1 s at x1). ticksPerCell is the time to cross one flat, open cell: settlers 20 ticks (0.5 cell a second), scouts 10 (1 cell a second); a migrating camp (a journey of a whole camp) journeyTicksPerCell. Terrain makes a cell slower (percent of a flat cell): hills, mountains, forests (forestBiomes), sea ice, and crossing a river on the edge between two cells adds riverPercent. Routes are searched with A* over walkable cells the civilization knows, looking at most at routeNodeLimit cells. Scouts: every settlement keeps one scout party walking: a new one sets out scoutEveryYears years of action (one year = 6 s at x1) after the last came back, walks scoutTripCells cells into the land in one direction (turning at water) and comes back the way it went; it sees sightCells around itself. Settlers carry food for settlerFoodMonths months of action and eat it (as warriors do, war.json foodPerWarriorPerYear); without food hungerDeathPercent of them die every month of action. If their place is taken when they arrive they look for another within foundSearchCells cells, else they go home.
